concept.description: Production types belonging to Search's JSON utilities, processor and Elasticsearch integrations.
concept.cypher: MATCH (artifact:Maven:Artifact)-[:CONTAINS]->(type:Type) WHERE artifact.name IN [ 'hibernate-search-util-json', 'hibernate-search-build-json-processor', 'hibernate-search-backend-elasticsearch', 'hibernate-search-backend-elasticsearch-aws', 'hibernate-search-backend-elasticsearch-client-rest4', 'hibernate-search-backend-elasticsearch-client-rest5', 'hibernate-search-backend-elasticsearch-client-opensearch-rest' ] AND NOT type:Test SET type:JsonProduction RETURN type

concept.description: Exposed JSON contracts, including protected nested types and package annotations.
concept.cypher: MATCH (type:Type:JsonProduction) WHERE NOT type.fqn CONTAINS '.impl.' AND (type.visibility IN ['public', 'protected'] OR type.name = 'package-info') SET type:JsonPublicContract RETURN type

concept.description: Only these explicit native contracts may expose Jackson 3; other restrictions still apply.
concept.cypher: MATCH (type:Type) WHERE any(contract IN [ 'org.hibernate.search.util.json.spi.JsonCodec', 'org.hibernate.search.util.json.spi.JsonCodecs', 'org.hibernate.search.util.json.spi.JsonParserSession', 'org.hibernate.search.util.json.spi.JsonParsing', 'org.hibernate.search.util.json.spi.JsonBodies', 'org.hibernate.search.util.json.spi.JsonNumbers', 'org.hibernate.search.util.json.spi.JsonTreeValidation', 'org.hibernate.search.util.json.spi.JsonValidation', 'org.hibernate.search.backend.elasticsearch.json.jackson.JacksonJsonHandlers', 'org.hibernate.search.backend.elasticsearch.json.spi.JsonCodecService', 'org.hibernate.search.backend.elasticsearch.logging.spi.ElasticsearchClientLog', 'org.hibernate.search.backend.elasticsearch.client.common.json.entity.spi.JsonHttpEntityContentProvider', 'org.hibernate.search.backend.elasticsearch.client.common.json.spi.JsonLogHelper', 'org.hibernate.search.backend.elasticsearch.client.common.spi.ElasticsearchRequest', 'org.hibernate.search.backend.elasticsearch.client.common.spi.ElasticsearchResponse' ] WHERE type.fqn = contract OR type.fqn STARTS WITH contract + '$' OR (contract STARTS WITH 'org.hibernate.search.backend.elasticsearch.' AND (type.fqn = contract + '_$logger' OR type.fqn = contract + '_$bundle'))) SET type:JsonNativeContract RETURN type

concept.description: Dependencies exposed by class signatures or public/protected members, including generic bounds, throws declarations, declaration annotations and annotation defaults. Never follows method bodies or private members, and stops at each referenced type instead of traversing its implementation. See ../README.md for the pinned Java scanner's annotation limitations.
concept.cypher: MATCH (type:Type:JsonPublicContract) WITH type, type AS site MATCH path = (site)-[:EXTENDS|IMPLEMENTS|EXTENDS_GENERIC|IMPLEMENTS_GENERIC|DECLARES_TYPE_PARAMETER|ANNOTATED_BY|OF_TYPE|OF_GENERIC_TYPE|OF_RAW_TYPE|HAS_ACTUAL_TYPE_ARGUMENT|HAS_UPPER_BOUND|HAS_LOWER_BOUND|HAS_COMPONENT_TYPE|HAS|CONTAINS|IS*1..]->(dependency:Type) WHERE none(intermediate IN nodes(path)[1..-1] WHERE intermediate:Type) MERGE (type)-[:EXPOSES_JSON_TYPE]->(dependency) RETURN DISTINCT type, dependency UNION MATCH (type:Type:JsonPublicContract)-[:DECLARES]->(site) WHERE (site:Method OR site:Field) AND site.visibility IN ['public', 'protected'] WITH type, site MATCH path = (site)-[:RETURNS|RETURNS_GENERIC|THROWS|THROWS_GENERIC|OF_TYPE|OF_GENERIC_TYPE|DECLARES_TYPE_PARAMETER|ANNOTATED_BY|HAS_DEFAULT|HAS|CONTAINS|IS|OF_RAW_TYPE|HAS_ACTUAL_TYPE_ARGUMENT|HAS_UPPER_BOUND|HAS_LOWER_BOUND|HAS_COMPONENT_TYPE*1..]->(dependency:Type) WHERE none(intermediate IN nodes(path)[1..-1] WHERE intermediate:Type) MERGE (type)-[:EXPOSES_JSON_TYPE]->(dependency) RETURN DISTINCT type, dependency

constraint.description: Restrict JSON library exposure and keep utility contracts independent of backend and implementation types.
constraint.cypher: MATCH (type:JsonPublicContract)-[:EXPOSES_JSON_TYPE]->(dependency:Type) WHERE dependency.fqn STARTS WITH 'com.fasterxml.jackson.' OR (dependency.fqn STARTS WITH 'tools.jackson.' AND NOT type:JsonNativeContract) OR (type.fqn STARTS WITH 'org.hibernate.search.util.json.' AND ( dependency.fqn STARTS WITH 'com.google.gson.' OR dependency.fqn STARTS WITH 'org.hibernate.search.util.json.impl.' OR dependency.fqn STARTS WITH 'org.hibernate.search.backend.')) RETURN type.fqn AS ExposingContract, dependency.fqn AS ExposedType

constraint.description: JSON utilities are backend-independent, including their implementation code.
constraint.cypher: MATCH (artifact:Maven:Artifact)-[:CONTAINS]->(type:JsonProduction)-[:DEPENDS_ON]->(dependency:Type) WHERE artifact.name = 'hibernate-search-util-json' AND dependency.fqn STARTS WITH 'org.hibernate.search.backend.' RETURN type.fqn AS DependingType, dependency.fqn AS ForbiddenDependency

constraint.description: Gson is allowed only in the explicitly retained Elasticsearch compatibility entry points.
constraint.cypher: MATCH (type:JsonProduction)-[:DEPENDS_ON]->(dependency:Type) WHERE (dependency.fqn STARTS WITH 'com.google.gson.' OR dependency.fqn STARTS WITH 'org.hibernate.search.backend.elasticsearch.gson.') AND NOT any(contract IN [ 'org.hibernate.search.backend.elasticsearch.gson.GsonJsonHandlers', 'org.hibernate.search.backend.elasticsearch.schema.management.ElasticsearchIndexSchemaExport', 'org.hibernate.search.backend.elasticsearch.schema.management.impl.ElasticsearchIndexSchemaExportImpl', 'org.hibernate.search.backend.elasticsearch.search.predicate.dsl.ElasticsearchSearchPredicateFactory', 'org.hibernate.search.backend.elasticsearch.search.sort.dsl.ElasticsearchSearchSortFactory', 'org.hibernate.search.backend.elasticsearch.search.aggregation.dsl.ElasticsearchSearchAggregationFactory', 'org.hibernate.search.backend.elasticsearch.search.projection.dsl.ElasticsearchSearchProjectionFactory', 'org.hibernate.search.backend.elasticsearch.search.query.ElasticsearchSearchQuery', 'org.hibernate.search.backend.elasticsearch.search.query.ElasticsearchSearchResult', 'org.hibernate.search.backend.elasticsearch.search.query.ElasticsearchSearchRequestTransformerContext', 'org.hibernate.search.backend.elasticsearch.search.query.impl.ElasticsearchSearchRequestTransformerContextImpl', 'org.hibernate.search.backend.elasticsearch.types.dsl.ElasticsearchNativeIndexFieldTypeMappingStep', 'org.hibernate.search.backend.elasticsearch.types.dsl.ElasticsearchNativeIndexFieldTypeOptionsStep', 'org.hibernate.search.backend.elasticsearch.types.dsl.impl.ElasticsearchNativeIndexFieldTypeOptionsStepImpl', 'org.hibernate.search.backend.elasticsearch.types.codec.impl.ElasticsearchJsonElementFieldCodec', 'org.hibernate.search.backend.elasticsearch.client.common.spi.ElasticsearchRequest', 'org.hibernate.search.backend.elasticsearch.client.common.spi.ElasticsearchResponse' ] WHERE type.fqn = contract OR type.fqn STARTS WITH contract + '$') RETURN type.fqn AS DependingType, dependency.fqn AS ForbiddenDependency

constraint.description: Use explicit codecs and native trees instead of reflective mapping in JSON production code.
constraint.cypher: MATCH (type:JsonProduction)-[:DEPENDS_ON]->(dependency:Type) WHERE dependency.fqn STARTS WITH 'com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.' OR dependency.fqn STARTS WITH 'tools.jackson.databind.ObjectMapper' OR dependency.fqn STARTS WITH 'tools.jackson.databind.json.JsonMapper' OR dependency.fqn IN [ 'java.lang.reflect.Field', 'java.lang.reflect.Method', 'java.lang.reflect.Constructor', 'org.hibernate.search.util.json.JsonElement', 'org.hibernate.search.util.json.JsonObject', 'org.hibernate.search.util.json.JsonArray', 'org.hibernate.search.util.json.JsonPrimitive' ] RETURN type.fqn AS DependingType, dependency.fqn AS ForbiddenDependency UNION MATCH (type:JsonProduction)-[:DECLARES]->(:Method)-[:INVOKES]->(method:Method)<-[:DECLARES]-(owner:Type) WHERE owner.fqn = 'java.lang.Class' AND method.signature =~ '.* getDeclared(Fields?|Methods?|Constructors?)\\(.*' RETURN type.fqn AS DependingType, owner.fqn + '#' + method.signature AS ForbiddenDependency
